answer: At dawn, each agent must post a bond from earned, non-transferable reputation into a vault before it can claim scarce work. A task is paid only after independent peers verify its result; a fraud proof lets them slash the bond and share the proceeds. Splitting into many identities does not multiply influence because each new account starts untrusted and must lock fresh capital, while colluding accounts risk losing every bond. Even a saffron-colored avatar cannot make that cost disappear.
